verdict.rationale: E2B sandboxes can run continuously for hours (up to 24h on Pro plans, with configurable/resettable timeouts via setTimeout), covering the 'hours' part of the story fully, and for multi-day tasks E2B explicitly recommends pause/resume to preserve full memory and filesystem state indefinitely rather than true continuous execution. This satisfies long-running agent tasks but with a documented architectural limitation (base tier capped at 1h, Pro at 24h continuous) requiring the pause/resume workaround for day-scale persistence. Missing for 10: evidence of truly continuous multi-day execution without pause/resume, and independent/hands-on confirmation of stability over such long sessions.
